sentences.en: You could have solved this puzzle with a little more patience.
sentences.zh: 你要是再多一点耐心就能解开这个谜题了。

sentences.en: I can't figure out how to solve the puzzle.
sentences.zh: 我搞不懂怎么解决这个难题。

sentences.en: I love to spend time trying to put together a puzzle.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢花时间拼凑智力玩具。
